findings.userImpact: A user whose text is refused for looking like a key or token sees only the raw English route string, not the plain-language 'remove that value and try again' recovery in either language.
findings.notReopened: Not a B1 version-binding, attempt, isolation or download defect; this is a route-to-panel string coupling that no accepted proof covered.

observations.text: If build B settles while superseded build A is still in flight and the form is edited back to A, pressing Build is a silent no-op with an idle button (guard at L07); A's late response is then discarded as superseded. B1 accepted the guard by design and the superseded notice explains it; no discriminating oracle was run. Not ranked.

A failed fetch, non-JSON body or HTTP error for the latest build shows 'Export failed', the build number and the raw (English) message in both languages. The copy makes no claim that nothing was sent, so it does not contradict any existing claim. Not a defect.

casePlan.oracle: Feed the string produced by the real route for a secret-like body (or a shared constant) to the panel and assert export-error-recovery shows the plain-language copy in en and vi; fails at the current bytes.

Unmount during pending; assert no state update warning and record that server outcome stays UNKNOWN.
Browser refresh during pending; record what the user sees; requires a browser run and is Local-admission only.
Latest-build network failure in the Vietnamese UI; record the visible language of the message.
